To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have proposed and implemented three hierarchical models for the dispatch of mobile agents.

1. the dispatch of multiple agents can be performed in parallel over different servers; 2. the time complexity is linear to the number of mobile agent and logarithm to the number of servers; 3. the dispatching time of mobile agents is reduced significantly; 4. the dispatching model is suitable for Internet marketplaces; 5. the dispatching models are scalable and can be easily extended.
(1) the dispatch of mobile agents can be parallelized; and (2) a hierarchical dispatch model can be designed to improve the dispatch performance.
In summary, our research is concerned with

how to improve the efficiency of dispatching multiple mobile agents over multiple hosts, and the results of this research will be useful for designing and implementing a large-scale parallel mobile agent system.
how to dispatch mobile agents in parallel, and how to achieve a high efficiency for mobile agent based Internet marketplaces.
how to make the dispatch of mobile agents scalable.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the dispatching of multiple mobile agents in a parallel way is feasible and can be processed efficiently.
the dispatch of multiple agents in parallel can be processed efficiently and effectively in our proposed hierarchical dispatch models.
the dispatching time can be reduced to a large degree if the dispatch is processed by a parallel way.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the hierarchical dispatch models are effective for dispatching multiple mobile agents and they can be easily applied to the framework presented in this paper.
, in the mobile agent approach, the dispatch can be processed in a parallel way over different hosts.
the dispatch of multiple agents can be processed efficiently in parallel over multiple hosts.
The main takeaway from our work is that
, for the mobile agent based Internet marketplace, parallel dispatching can be used to enhance the efficiency of dispatching multiple mobile agents.

the dispatching process of multiple mobile agents in a distributed way can be processed in a much more efficient way than the traditional serial dispatch approach, especially when the number of mobile agent becomes very large.
the parallel dispatch of multiple mobile agent is feasible and can be implemented in practice.
